headline: Yen Holds Steady Ahead of BOJ as AI Worries Fuel U.S. Treasury Rally
summary: The Japanese yen remained steady ahead of a Bank of Japan meeting, while concerns surrounding artificial intelligence sparked a rally in U.S. Treasuries and pressured the dollar.
why: Bank of Japan policy choices influence global bond yield spreads and FX carry trades, while Treasury swings dictate broader global borrowing benchmarks.

impacts.name: U.S. Dollar Index
impacts.why: Declining Treasury yields reduce the yield premium supporting the U.S. dollar against peer currencies.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Treasury yields dropped amid AI-related tech risk aversion, dampening the greenback while traders kept the yen stable before the BOJ decision.
